classification_rule: REUSE_INTERNAL = pre-qualified in IP/index.md (STRONG, silicon-proven) with licence confirmed. REUSE_GITHUB = external repo, licence + purity verified 2026-08-19 from source headers / GitHub API. CREATE = no qualified pure-Verilog source exists (or licence uncertain with no clean fallback other than custom RTL). BLACKBOX = analog macro / compiled SRAM with pin-exact interface, no RTL. FLAG = licence or availability uncertainty requiring a documented fallback; never silently assumed (constraint 13).

summary.reuse_ratio_formula: reuse_total / (reuse_total + create_total) = 10/15 = 0.667 (core, excluding blackbox analog MOD-16 and deferred DMA MOD-17); with MOD-17: 10/16 = 0.625
flags: FLAG-CONSTRAINT13 x2 (MOD-03, MOD-04 bridges -> CREATE fallback)
FLAG-NO-LICENSE-FILE x2 (OpenCores CAN repo root, EF_PWM32 repo root — licences declared in file headers)
FLAG-LGPL (OpenCores CAN: LGPL-2.1+ — thesis use OK, commercial path needs maintainer confirmation)
FLAG-INDEX-GAP (EF_PWM32 not in IP/index.md — register during reuse qualification)
FLAG-COMPILED-MACRO (OpenRAM — macros are compiled views; behavioural Verilog for sim)
summary.deviation_from_opus: Opus §3.2 counted wb2axip as REUSE for the AXI->AHB bridge (12/15 = 0.80). Verification on 2026-08-19 found wb2axip contains NO AHB bridge (Wishbone<->AXI/APB only, plus one .vhd wrapper). Both bridges reclassified to CREATE fallback -> reuse ratio 0.667 (10/15). No IP is silently assumed (constraint 13).
summary.zero_sv_vhdl_scan: Required at RTL stage (REQ-014): find <rtl_root> -name '*.sv' -o -name '*.vhd' -o -name '*.vhdl' | wc -l == 0. Known trap: wb2axip repo contains axlite_wrapper.vhd — EXCLUDED from the RTL file list; if wb2axip files are ever imported, only whitelisted .v files are taken.
